router_fused_blockm_invariance.label: router_fused_blockm_invariance
router_fused_blockm_invariance.why: the kernel's output is invariant to BLOCK_M by construction (sq is a full-K per-row reduction, recomputed identically by every n-tile), so any dependence on it is a codegen/hardware defect, not arithmetic. BLOCK_M >= 64 is where Triton switches tl.dot to the async wgmma path.

combined.note: unfused = 1 norm + router GEMM + w13 GEMM; fused = router GEMM + w13 GEMM (x2 never materialized)

half_fused.note: EXPLORATORY, not the headline: rstd from a tiny reduction kernel, applied as a pure epilogue scale. 2 activation passes vs the unfused side's 3 and the fused side's 1; GEMM k-loop identical to unfused.

moe_reference.row_index_map: A row = idx // TOPK, C row = idx; matches the kernel's safe_token // top_k / safe_token
moe_reference.caveat: max-abs rel_err over a sampled subset under-reports the full-row figure (measured: by at most ~32% at T=8192); rows the kernel never wrote are caught separately by NaN-arming the output, not by this sample
